headline: Weather is slowing Washington Dulles and Newark; Dulles is lagging on time.

items.text: The 174 United flights in the air are 64% fewer than usual for this time of day, when the median over the past 7 days was 488. United schedules far fewer flights than usual for Thanksgiving Day.

Washington Dulles is the lowest of the seven United hubs reporting so far today, with 60% of departures leaving within 30 minutes of schedule (160 departed). Very low clouds and rain are slowing arrivals and departures significantly there.
Newark has low visibility and rain, enough to slow arrivals and departures.
The other hubs are running normally.
